about: PLAN-rmcp-local-mcp LM2 and LM10 (decision D57): one verdict per MCP tool whose contract command is not proxyCapable. After LM10 every executor and in-memory tool of the LM2 table is served on the hosted executor (proxyCapable, marker proxy) and left this table; what remains is local = never served remotely, admitted only on basis caller-disk (it reads or writes the caller's own disk) or terminal (it needs one). COMMAND_METADATA mcpSurface carries the same kind, basis and reason; packages/cli/src/commands/mcp/__tests__/mcp-coverage.test.ts holds the two equal and refuses a missing tool.

cluster kubeconfig.reason: Writes the kubeconfig to a 0600 file on the caller's own disk and prints that path.

config audit log.reason: Reads the audit log file on the caller's own disk.

config audit verify.reason: Verifies the hash chain of the audit log file on the caller's own disk.

config current.reason: Names the config file the caller's own install selects, with its file path and token file state.

config list.reason: Lists the config files on the caller's own disk; a session holds exactly one granted config.

machine infra cert status.reason: Reports the certificate cache files under the caller's own config directory; the executor holds no such cache.

server status.reason: Finds the server through the caller's own local install record.

version.reason: Reports the CLI build installed on the caller's own machine and its update channel.
